check.title: Then it checks the work
check.sub: Before anything goes live, Brand Check reviews it against {name}'s guidelines, flags potential issues, and shows which guideline informed each finding.
check.note: Brand Check runs on the context you already keep in Frontify. It's more than a prompt: it's a service built into Frontify, available in the portal and through the API. The image is fictional AI-generated work content, and the findings are samples.

asset.by: fictional, made with a generic AI image tool
asset.alt: A fictional AI-generated LinkedIn graphic: posed advisors in suits, a teal-to-navy color wash and a generic headline

findings.text: The teal-to-navy wash isn't in the palette. CIBC red leads, on white.
findings.recommendation: Lead with CIBC red, #C41F3E, on white, with burgundy and charcoal in support and no color wash over photos.

findings.text: "Your Wealth, Our Expertise" is a generic line, and a wealth headline needs the approved disclosures before it goes out.
findings.recommendation: Start from the approved Private Wealth positioning, and add the required disclosures from the template.

findings.text: A posed group smiling at the camera doesn't match the photography style.
findings.recommendation: Use a candid photo of a real team at work from the photo library.

contexts.eyebrow: Use case 2 · What context lives in Frontify
contexts.title: Every kind of context, in one place
contexts.sub: Brand, creative, product, advisor and vendor guidance live in {name}'s portal, plus an Everyday section with short versions for every employee. People read them, and AI tools answer from them.
contexts.note: Sample pages built from CIBC's public brand information. Not CIBC's own guidelines.

items.label: Brand
items.title: Our palette
items.rule: CIBC red leads. Burgundy and charcoal support it, and white keeps it open.
items.ask: Which color should a social post lead with?
items.answer: Lead with **CIBC red, #C41F3E**, on white. Burgundy and charcoal support it.

items.label: Creative
items.title: Photography
items.lead: Real teams doing real work, never staged.

do.label: Teams at work
do.note: Candid moments of people working together.

dont.label: Posed for the camera
dont.note: No staged handshakes or stock smiles.

items.ask: Can I use a stock photo of a handshake?
items.answer: Better not. The photography guidelines ask for **candid teamwork**, and **no staged handshakes or stock smiles**.

items.label: Everyday
items.desc: Short rules for email, decks and docs
items.title: Email tone of voice
items.lead: The short version of our tone of voice, for everyone who sends email.
rules: Say what you need in under eight words.
Lead with the ask or the answer.
Use the standard signature. No quotes or images.
items.do: Can you review the launch plan by Thursday?
items.dont: Just circling back on the below!!
items.askLabel: Before sending, with your AI assistant
items.ask: Check this email against our writing guidelines.
items.answer: Two fixes before you send: **put the ask in the first line**, and **use the standard signature**.
items.from: Condensed from Brand › Tone of voice

items.label: Vendors
items.desc: What vendors and agencies send, and how
items.title: Vendor submission guide
items.lead: What vendors and agencies need to know before they send work.
steps: Through Vendors › Submit an asset in the portal, not over FTP or email.
Campaign, usage rights and an expiry date.
Approved logos, photos and templates in the portal.
items.rule: Every submission needs usage rights and an expiry date.
items.askLabel: A vendor asks the brand assistant
items.ask: How do we send final files to the brand team?
items.answer: **Submit them in the portal** under Vendors › Submit an asset, with **usage rights and an expiry date**. They land in the Vendor submissions library.

everyday.eyebrow: Use case 4 · Everyday guidelines, inside your office applications
everyday.title: The right tone in every email and deck
everyday.sub: Most of {name} will never open a brand portal. With Frontify connected, your AI assistant inside your email and presentation apps reads the Everyday guidelines and checks the work before it goes out.
everyday.note: Your agent embedded in your enterprise apps, usually ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Gemini, can read Frontify guidelines and use them as a reference and rule set for any suggested changes. Sample email, presentation and guidelines.

tabs.label: Email
tabs.ask: Check this email against our email tone of voice before I send it.
tabs.intro: Three fixes based on **Everyday › Email tone of voice**:

before.subject: Following up
body: Hi team, just circling back on the below!!
We've been heads-down on the Private Wealth brand refresh and there's a lot going on, so I wanted to share where things stand.
Can you review the launch plan by Thursday?

after.subject: Review the brand refresh plan by Thursday
body: Hi team, can you review the brand refresh plan by Thursday?
It covers the messaging, launch assets and timeline. Comments in the doc are perfect.

fixes.label: Subject:
fixes.note: say what you need. "Following up" doesn't.

fixes.label: Opening:
fixes.note: lead with the ask. It's in the last line right now.

fixes.label: Sign-off:
fixes.note: use the standard signature, with no quotes.

tabs.done: Updated. The draft matches the email tone of voice and is ready to send.

tabs.label: Presentation
tabs.ask: Is this slide built the way our presentation guidelines say?

before.title: Q3 results and some thoughts on where we go next with CIBC Private Wealth

fixes.label: Template:

fixes.label: Title:
fixes.note: 14 words. Keep titles to six or fewer.

fixes.label: Bullets:

partners.eyebrow: Use case 5 · Vendor and agency files
partners.title: Vendor files land in the right place
partners.sub: Vendors and agencies submit work straight into {name}'s portal. Files land in the right library, and the assistant tags them and sets an expiry date in one sentence.
partners.note: Sample files, vendor and library. The assistant acts on the assets you select: workflow status, metadata, tags and expiry dates.
partners.ask: Tag these Private Wealth and Cleared for external use, and set them to expire Dec 31, 2026.
partners.plan: I'll add the tags Private Wealth and Cleared for external use, and set Available until to Dec 31, 2026, on the 2 selected assets. Say yes and I'll apply it.
partners.you: You're the vendor. Then see what the brand team gets.
